en.title: Daily Accessibility Digest - May 27, 2026
en.summary: Today's highlights include NASA's Parker Solar Probe providing sonified solar wind with video descriptions for blind audiences, an eight-year-old visually impaired boy from Oman championing inclusion and independence through assistive tech, and a blind gamer calling out missing accessibility features in recent game releases.

highlights.title: NASA Parker Solar Probe Solar Wind Audio with Video Description
Eight‑year‑old visually impaired boy champions inclusion and independence
Blind gamer highlights lack of accessibility in new game releases
